correctness.rationale: Classified P4-free selections in K_(a,b) minus a size-t matching: no shared selected pair, or one selected side has size 1, or both sides select the same two deleted matched indices. Disjoint enumeration gives (1+u+v)^t(1+u)^(a-t)(1+v)^(b-t)+tuv[(1+u)^(a-1)+(1+v)^(b-1)-1]+C(t,2)u^2v^2, including t=0 and singleton classes. Consecutive matching-deletion difference reduces to nonnegative selections on both sides, with coefficient (a-1)(b-1)-2t at uv; its only full equality case is (3,3,2). For crowns, maximal sets split into two-sided full-index partitions, one-side singleton/full other side, or paired 2x2 sets, producing stated bivariate maximal polynomial. Independent induced-P4 direct enumeration confirmed all 1<=a,b<=5 and all t, and independently confirmed maximal-facet distributions for crowns n=3..6. Infinite coefficient inequalities are from the symbolic counting, not finite tests.

value.rationale: A full bivariate hereditary-subgraph counting polynomial and classification of all inclusion-minimal deletion sets on a natural dense bipartite graph family have independent combinatorial use. The coefficientwise deletion paradox and arbitrarily long gaps in possible maximal cograph sizes are motivated structural effects rather than arbitrary small instances.

limitations: Generic cograph structure and algorithmic P4 deletion are classical and not claimed novel.
Crown maximal-set formula is for full perfect matching deletion, not all partial matchings.
